snippet.title: Hunt: Showdown 1896 | Legends Return | Into the Infinite 2025
snippet.description:
Hunt: Showdown 1896’s latest event brings the rain with the return of Thundershower Time of Day and weary Hunters with Legends Return.
 
They’ve walked different paths shaped by pain and choices made in blood. What brought them back wasn’t fate, but something far more dangerous.

Dive into corrupted backwaters lost to time, where twisted monsters and rival Hunters stand between you and your bounty.

Play now: https://lvli.li/HS1896

Developed by Crytek
 
#IntoTheInfinite #gamescom2025 #HuntShowdown1896
